description: This file defines the ReminderOptions class and its validator within the Orleans.Hosting namespace, providing configuration options for the reminder service such as reminder periods and validation logic.

classes.name: ReminderOptions
classes.description: A sealed class representing configuration options for the Orleans reminder service, including minimum reminder period, refresh period, and initialization timeout.
